mcqs.question: According to the CMS estimate, what was the approximate cost of the 2024 election, compared with ₹60,000 crore in 2019?
mcqs.explanation: The CMS estimated the cost of the 2024 election at about ₹1.35 lakh crore, compared with ₹60,000 crore in 2019. ₹60,000 crore was the 2019 figure, while ₹7 lakh crore and ₹10,000 crore refer to other estimates mentioned in the policy debate.
